This AD defines the unsafe condition as cracking in the rotary rudder boom or pylon due to fatigue, failure from static overload, and subsequent loss of control of the helicopter.

The actions specified by this AD are intended to detect cracking in the rotary rudder boom or pylon due to fatigue, and to prevent failure from static overload and subsequent loss of control of the helicopter.
